title: January 2027 · New Mercies
headline: Wake up to
lead: One verse for every January morning. A gentle chime fades in, then that day's verse is read aloud, so the first voice you hear is God's.
seasonSub: Thirty mornings, each with its own verse, in date order. Tap any day to hear it now.
librarySub: Every verse this month, one per morning. Tap ▶ to hear it; tap again to stop.
footer: January 2027 — one verse for each morning, in date order, so everyone who wakes with this alarm hears the same verse that morning. Verses in the King James (public-domain) rendering.

photoCaption.title: First light, first Word.
photoCaption.text: Before the news, before the phone buzzes — the day's verse, spoken out loud to start the morning.

sideVerse.t: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.t: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
